runSummary.note: Real 17 Sep 04:58 sweep. Twelve independent source families were actually queried: Profesia, direct company/public careers, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Praca za rohom, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, WordPress public jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities, and public Facebook indexing. No promotion-grade new job was found. Wolt Bratislava/remote support is location-eligible but requires minimum B2 English plus 07:00-01:00 shift coverage including weekends. Allegro/Mall 100% HO partner support is strong operationally but requires fluent Hungarian and Slovak. detect Bratislava offers 2000 EUR but is a system-administrator/IT specialist role beyond the preferred technical ceiling. Upwork still has a good WooCommerce product-listing role at $10-30/h, but it is three weeks old with 20-50 proposals, one hire and four interviews. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable posts.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Language hard-gate parser
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Extract explicit CEFR levels and named mandatory languages from canonical details before ranking. Separate optional/nice-to-have language mentions from hard requirements so strong remote roles such as Wolt or Allegro are rejected early when B2 or Hungarian is mandatory.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Shift-window burden score
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Model not only whether shifts exist but the operating window, weekend frequency and latest finish. Penalize roles with broad 07:00-01:00 coverage more strongly than ordinary daytime rotation, saving review time and improving compatibility ranking.

policy.contentAgeVsVerificationAge: updatedAt/contentUpdatedAt describes data-content age; sourceVerificationAt describes when sources were actually checked; each job verifiedAt describes that job's evidence age.
policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.discovery: List/search resurfacing can create a candidate but never verifiedAt or LIVE promotion by itself.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No unsafe write to jobs-data, job-sources or MASTER is attempted where full round-trip content cannot be guaranteed.
